resources.string: A private skincare companion built around thoughtful routines, personal tracking, and evidence-led guidance.
This foundation build does not capture, import, or save photos. Photo tracking is planned to keep images on your device by default.
This app does not diagnose skin conditions or promise skin whitening. Actionable guidance will be added only after appropriate safety and evidence review.
FOUNDATION BUILD · NO SKIN ANALYSIS ENABLED
Photo capture and skin analysis are not available yet. Any future analysis will need its own evidence, accuracy, privacy, and device-performance checks before release.
Routine planning is being designed around your preferences and safety needs. No products or treatments are being recommended by this build.
A private progress timeline is planned. This version does not save photos, skin notes, or progress history, and it will not infer improvement from images alone.
The ingredient catalogue is not active yet. Entries will need traceable sources, review dates, and clear safety limits before appearing here.
Language and privacy controls will be added before personal data features. This build has no account, analytics, or cloud sync.
